SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Agreement is entered into between Northwind Labs Ltd. (the Client) and Brightside Studio LLC (the Provider).

CHAPTER I - DEFINITIONS AND SCOPE

Article 1. Definitions
In this Agreement Deliverables means the software, documentation and materials that the Provider
creates for the Client. Confidential Information means any non-public technical or business
information disclosed by one party to the other.

Article 2. Scope of services
The Provider shall design, develop and test a mobile inventory application as described in Schedule A.
Any work outside Schedule A requires a written change order signed by both parties.

Article 3. Term
This Agreement starts on the Effective Date and continues for twelve months unless terminated earlier
under Chapter IV. It renews automatically for successive six month periods unless either party gives
sixty days written notice of non-renewal.

CHAPTER II - FEES AND PAYMENT

Article 4. Fees
The Client shall pay the Provider a fixed fee of one hundred and twenty thousand dollars, divided
into four equal milestone payments as listed in Schedule B.

Article 5. Invoices and payment terms
The Provider shall invoice each milestone upon its acceptance. The Client shall pay every invoice
within thirty days of receipt. Undisputed amounts paid late accrue interest at one and a half
percent per month.

Article 6. Expenses and taxes
Travel expenses require prior written approval. All fees are exclusive of value added tax,
which the Client shall pay in addition where applicable.

CHAPTER III - INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AND CONFIDENTIALITY

Article 7. Ownership of deliverables
Upon full payment, all rights in the Deliverables transfer to the Client. The Provider keeps
ownership of its pre-existing tools and libraries and grants the Client a perpetual licence to use
them as part of the Deliverables.

Article 8. Confidentiality
Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information secret and use it only to perform
this Agreement. This duty survives for five years after termination.
The duty does not apply to information that is public through no fault of the receiving party.

Article 9. Data protection
The Provider shall process personal data only on the Client's documented instructions and shall
notify the Client of any data breach within seventy-two hours of becoming aware of it.

CHAPTER IV - TERMINATION AND LIABILITY

Article 10. Termination for cause
Either party may terminate this Agreement by written notice if the other party commits a material
breach and fails to remedy it within fifteen days after receiving notice of the breach.

Article 11. Termination for convenience
The Client may terminate for convenience with thirty days notice, paying for all work completed
up to the termination date.

Article 12. Limitation of liability
The total liability of the Provider under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid in the
twelve months before the claim. Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential losses,
such as lost profits.

Article 13. Warranty
The Provider warrants that the Deliverables will conform to Schedule A for ninety days after
acceptance and will repair any defect reported during that period at no charge.

CHAPTER V - GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 14. Governing law and disputes
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware. The parties shall first try to
resolve any dispute by mediation, and failing that, by binding arbitration in Wilmington.

Article 15. Force majeure
Neither party is liable for delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control, such as natural
disasters, war, strikes or failures of public utilities, provided it notifies the other party promptly.

Article 16. Assignment and notices
Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other.
Notices must be sent in writing to the addresses stated on the signature page.
